item.arkandayim.black_book.tip: The last page holds the coordinates of a place.
item.arkandayim.null_totem.tip: Hold it and nul is struck down by lightning when it reaches you.
arkandayim.menu.sub: something in the night is watching you
arkandayim.dark.hint: Pitch black... press H for the flashlight
arkandayim.book.given: A black book was placed in your inventory.
arkandayim.book.p1.title: THE BLACK BOOK
arkandayim.book.p1.l1: I do not know who wrote this. The first pages were blank, then the words appeared on their own.
arkandayim.book.p1.l2: It speaks of a house. A house whose lights are still on, yet nobody lives there.
arkandayim.book.p2.title: SECOND PAGE
arkandayim.book.p2.l1: The house stands within a hundred blocks of where you were born. Its door is always open, its inside always warm.
arkandayim.book.p2.l2: But something walks its halls. Its steps sound like yours, its shadow does not.
arkandayim.book.p2.l3: Where you step on black soil no leaves fall, because the trees there are dead.
arkandayim.book.p3.title: LAST PAGE
arkandayim.book.p3.l1: The door of the house is at:
arkandayim.book.p3.l2: If you go there at night, do not forget to knock. It is waiting for you too.
arkandayim.book.p3.none: This page is still blank. The house has not been written yet.
arkandayim.panel.title: Behind You Panel
arkandayim.panel.creative_hint: You must be in creative mode to take items.
arkandayim.panel.house_built: The house is built and its coordinates are in the black book.
arkandayim.panel.dark_arrived: You are in the middle of a dark biome.
arkandayim.panel.knock_done: The door was knocked. A box was left behind.
arkandayim.panel.creative_only: Creative mode is required to take items.
advancements.arkandayim.null_oldur.title: null is dead
advancements.arkandayim.null_oldur.descr: Silence nul forever with the brown sword.
advancements.arkandayim.izleniyorum.desc: Stand perfectly still for ten minutes. Something is watching you.
advancements.arkandayim.efsanevi_kilic.t: the legendary sword only kills this null
advancements.arkandayim.efsanevi_kilic.d: Craft the brown sword. The sky remembers it.
item.arkandayim.arkandayim_compass.tip: Points at the house. Right click for bearing and distance.
item.arkandayim.shadow_totem.tip: Right click: slip away from null and turn invisible.
item.arkandayim.guardian_totem.tip: While carried it swallows one killing blow.
arkandayim.chat.null: You said its name. It heard you.
arkandayim.compass.none: The house has not been written yet.
arkandayim.totem.guardian_used: The guardian totem wraps around you.
arkandayim.totem.guardian_saved: The guardian totem pulled you back from death.
